* Ability to develop and maintain KT trackers, readiness dashboards, and structured governance reporting
* Proficiency in project tracking and collaboration tools
* Familiarity with transition methodologies, KT frameworks, and stage\-gate governance


Behavioral Competencies

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Clear and proactive communicator with strong interpersonal skills across diverse, global teams
* Results\-oriented mindset with strong attention to delivery commitments and accountability

* Support the planning, coordination, tracking, and closure of multiple concurrent software\-as\-a\-service implementation projects by maintaining accurate project plans, actions, RAID logs, milestone records, and delivery documentation.
* Coordinate project governance routines, including status reporting, meeting preparation, action and decision follow\-up, milestone tracking, documentation reviews, and adherence to standard delivery processes across Agile, waterfall, and hybrid delivery models.

* Working knowledge of Agile, waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies, with experience supporting governance, reporting, audit checks, or project health tracking.

* Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 5% including occasional overnight travel

**D. Comms \& Change Management**


Run the internal hub comms rhythm — stand\-ups, updates, onboarding comms — and the Dubai* India information flow, so both sides always hold the same picture

* A well\-led, controlled and compliant hub with zero data\-security incidents

### **Experience**


* 8–10 years in PMO / programme management, transformation delivery or capability\-center / delivery\-hub leadership (Senior Manager level)
* Direct experience standing up and running an offshore / nearshore delivery hub or capability center (GCC / GDC) — mobilisation through steady\-state
* Strong PMO background — governance, planning, work breakdown, tracking, utilisation and reporting; proven leadership of distributed teams across locations and cultures


**Capabilities**

* Reporting and dashboarding — presenting outputs to leadership

**AI, Automation \& Digital Tools (Group standard)**

**5\. Behavioral Traits**


* Structured and disciplined (PMO\-minded)

* Excellent communicator

A well\-governed India hub — stood up on a clear operating model and run on PMO discipline — work broken into tasks and tracked to completion, timesheets and utilisation visible, SLAs met and data handled securely, comms and change managed, and clear outputs presented to leadership so they always know exactly what is happening and delivery lands on plan.
